merge_panda_robotiq_models: merge panda_nohand.xml and 2f85.xml into a combined panda_robotiq.xml model file
insert_robotiq_defaults: insert robotiq default tags into the panda model XML
attach_robotiq_body: attach robotiq worldbody content to the panda model at the attachment_site placeholder
add_cartesian_actuators: replace panda actuators with cartesian end-effector and finger position actuators
enable_gravity_compensation: add gravcomp attribute to all panda bodies for gravity compensation
